staticText: Private exact integer and rational number-base converter for bases 2 through 36. Inputs are capped at 512 digits and displayed fractions at 32 output digits; results must be labelled exact, repeating, or truncated. Two’s-complement views are signed 8, 16, 32, or 64 bit; bitwise operations are signed 32 bit; IEEE views use browser Float32 or Float64 rounding. Conversion inputs stay local and exported summaries should state the active precision boundary.
